messages: My sister Lucía just moved to Montreal. She got a job as a nurse at the Jewish General Hospital.
That's a big move! Montreal winters are cold; is she ready?
She bought a huge coat. She starts at the hospital next Monday.
episodes.summary: The user's sister Lucía moved to Montreal for a nurse job at the Jewish General Hospital.

messages: Mi hermano Pedro se casa el 14 de febrero en Puerto Plata y me pidió que sea su padrino.
¡Felicidades! Ser padrino es un honor. ¿Ya pensaste en el discurso?
Sí, voy a contar cuando nos perdimos en el Pico Duarte de niños.
Una anécdota perfecta para un brindis.
episodes.summary: El hermano del usuario, Pedro, se casa el 14 de febrero en Puerto Plata; el usuario será su padrino y contará la anécdota del Pico Duarte.

messages: My favorite café is La Cafetera on Calle El Conde. I go every Saturday morning.
A good ritual. What do you order?
Always a cortado and a pastelito de queso.
episodes.summary: The user's favorite café is La Cafetera on Calle El Conde; every Saturday, a cortado and a pastelito de queso.

messages: Je commence des cours de piano le mardi soir au conservatoire.
Oui, jouer une valse de Chopin d'ici la fin de l'année.
episodes.summary: L'utilisateur prend des cours de piano le mardi soir au conservatoire; objectif: une valse de Chopin d'ici la fin de l'année.

messages: The billing project's migration keeps failing on a circular dependency between invoices and customers.
Split the migration so the foreign key is added in a second step.
That worked: I moved the customer foreign key to migration 0004.
episodes.summary: The billing project's circular migration dependency was fixed by moving the customer foreign key to migration 0004.

messages: I sprained my knee playing basketball. The doctor said no running for three weeks.
Swimming is a gentle alternative meanwhile.
Good idea, I'll swim on Wednesdays.
episodes.summary: The user sprained their knee playing basketball: no running for three weeks; swimming on Wednesdays instead.

messages: El carro me dejó tirado; Ramón, el mecánico, dice que es la bomba de gasolina.
18,000 pesos con la mano de obra, me lo entrega el viernes.
Menos mal que no es el motor.
I booked a dentist appointment with Dr. Almonte for February 2 at 10am.
Noted: February 2 at 10:00 with Dr. Almonte.
episodes.summary: The user has a dentist appointment with Dr. Almonte on February 2 at 10:00.
